question: As per Sample Registration System (SRS) 2020, which of the following states had the highest infant mortality rate?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• As per the **Sample Registration System (SRS) 2020**, **Madhya Pradesh** had the **highest infant mortality rate (IMR)** among Indian states.
 
• The **Infant Mortality Rate (IMR)** refers to the number of infant deaths (under one year of age) per 1,000 live births in a given year.
